data.name: Vikranth
data.gender_notes: Vikranth is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: One who has the power to conquer and rule. The name Vikranth carries the meaning “Powerful Warrior” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Tamil. Parents who choose Vikranth usually hope their child will grow to embody powerful warrior and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name for those who seek to overcome their inner demons and assert their divine power in the world
data.etymology: Vikranth belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Powerful Warrior.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Vikranth total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.

in_sanskrit.name: विक्रांत
in_sanskrit.meaning: विक्रीयते रात्रिः (vikrīyate rātriḥ) - The one who makes the night active
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The one who has the power to make the night active and productive, just like a valiant warrior.

in_hindi.name: विक्रांथ
in_hindi.meaning: विकास करना (vikās karnā) - To develop or progress
in_hindi.long_meaning: The name signifies the ability to develop, progress, and overcome obstacles, just like a fearless warrior.

in_tamil.name: விக்க்ராந்த
in_tamil.meaning: விழவ்வுக்கான் ராஜ்யம் (viṙavvukkāṉ rājyam) - The king of valour
in_tamil.long_meaning: The name signifies the possessor of immense courage and the ruler of all situations, just like a brave and powerful king.

in_telugu.name: విక్రంథ
in_telugu.long_meaning: The name signifies the one who brings victory in all aspects of life, just like a victorious king or a mighty warrior.

in_marathi.name: Vikranth

data.cultural_impact: The name "Vikranth" carries a sense of power, strength, and leadership. In Hindu mythology, gods and gods are often described as having the power to rule and conquer, and Vikranth embodies this idea. It is also a popular name among people in Tamil Nadu, India, where it is believed that the name brings good fortune, success, and strength.
data.spiritual_significance: The spiritual significance of the name "Vikranth" lies in its association with inner strength and the power to overcome obstacles. In Hinduism, the divineGod Vishnu is often depicted as "Viraahbhoota," which means the one who gives strength to the weak. By adopting the name Vikranth, an individual is reminding themselves of their inherent strength and inner power. This name can serve as a reminder to persevere in the face of challenges, and to maintain a strong and unwavering spirit. Overall, the name Vikranth represents the idea that no matter what obstacles we face, we have the power within us to triumph and conquer.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Vikranth: The name Vikranth signifies one who transcends all limitations and boundaries, embodying the spirit of courage, determination, and infinite potential. This name inspires the bearer to break free from restrictions and embrace the boundless expanse of life.

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Vikranth was a king of the Chola dynasty in the 11th century AD. The name Vikranth carried significant spiritual weight in that era.

trends: The name Vikranth is gaining popularity in India due to the success of actor Vikranth in the Tamil film industry.
The name is also used as a given name for boys in India.
modern_usage.modern_context: The name Vikranth remains relevant in modern Hindu society, representing a bridge between traditional Vedic values and contemporary life. It is widely discussed on digital platforms and continues to be a popular choice for families seeking meaningful Hindu names.

name_in_real_life.story: A devoted individual named Lakshmi Vikranth in Mumbai, India attributes much of their spiritual journey to their name Vikranth, which means "Powerful Warrior". They believe their name has guided them on the path of righteousness.
